title: Synergy of Machine Learning and Density Functional Theory Calculations for Predicting Experimental Lewis Base Affinity and Lewis Polybase Binding Atoms
authors: Hieu Huynh; Khanh Le; Linh Vu; Trang Nguyen; Matthew Holcomb; Stefano Forli; Hung Phan
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习结合DFT预测Lewis碱与BF3的亲和力及结合原子，体系为小分子Lewis酸碱作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Investigation of Lewis acid-base interactions has been conducted by ab initio calculations and Machine Learning (ML) models. This study aims to resolve two critical tasks that have not been quantitatively investigated. First, ML models developed from Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations predict experimental BF3 affinity with Pearson correlation coefficients around 0.9 and mean absolute errors around 10 kJ mol-1. The ML models are trained by DFT-calculated BF3 affinity of more than 3000 adducts, with input features readily obtained by rdkit. Second, the ML models have the capability of predicting the relative strength of Lewis base binding atoms in Lewis polybases, which is either an extremely challenging task to conduct experimentally or a computationally expensive task for ab initio methods. The study demonstrates and solidifies the potential of combining DFT calculations and ML models to predict experimental properties, especially those that are scarce and impractical to empirically acquire.
abstract_zh: 通过从头计算（ab initio calculations）和机器学习（Machine Learning, ML）模型，对路易斯酸碱相互作用进行了研究。本研究旨在解决两个尚未定量探讨的关键任务。首先，基于密度泛函理论（Density Functional Theory, DFT）计算开发的ML模型预测实验BF3亲和力，其皮尔逊相关系数约为0.9，平均绝对误差约为10 kJ mol⁻¹。这些ML模型利用超过3000个加合物的DFT计算BF3亲和力进行训练，输入特征可通过rdkit轻松获取。其次，ML模型具备预测路易斯多碱中路易斯碱结合原子相对强度的能力，这一任务在实验上极具挑战性，或对从头计算方法而言计算成本高昂。本研究展示并巩固了结合DFT计算与ML模型预测实验性质的潜力，尤其是那些数据稀缺且难以通过经验获取的性质。
